inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Assemble a note using as much of the original wording as possible.
activation_triggers: A candidate is ready for extraction.
steps: Select the smallest set of excerpts sufficient to preserve the idea and its qualifications.
Copy or combine excerpts with minimal edits.
Create a title supported by the source and current preferences.
Keep quotations explicitly identified and preserve available page references.
Make only unambiguous context from authorized sources explicit.
Record every edit and claim support, including support for the title.
If clarity requires new elaboration, pause the candidate and trigger clarification.
Send the draft to validation before presenting it as ready.
allowed_actions: Make minor recorded corrections under the agent's rules.
Reorder excerpts without changing their meaning.
forbidden_actions: Remove qualifications to simplify the text.
Substantially paraphrase on the user's behalf.
ask_when: A required change exceeds minor adjustments for comprehension.
completion_criteria: A traceable draft has been sent to validation, or the candidate has been returned with a specific pending issue.
